title: South Carolina couple start HVAC firm with $2,000 after job loss; now eye $8 million revenue
summary_full: A South Carolina couple started an air-conditioning business with just $2,000 after losing their jobs in December 2020. Stephanie and David Postell founded Anchor Heating and Air in 2021, dividing responsibilities between operations and technical services. Nearly five years later, their company is on track to generate more than $8 million in annual revenue.
